audit.source: MassGIS residential parcels and mapped roads; available addresses, not a complete current municipal directory. Shared-address structures are grouped.
audit.roadAlignment: MassDOT centerlines retained in EPSG:26986, metres. Aerial comparison available.
audit.curbs: Source sidewalk widths used where recorded. Curb positions are derived from centerlines and widths, not a surveyed curb inventory.
audit.signs: Not displayed in address mode; the previous sign dataset was incomplete.
audit.elevation: MassGIS LiDAR 2013–2021 DEM, requested at 4 m, lightly smoothed. Not a road survey.
